description: This script sets up a Git repository scenario to test the 'git blame' command with specific options such as --reverse and --first-parent. It creates commits, merges, and verifies blame outputs on a file named 'file.t'.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified modifications or message.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation between specified commits or branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
